name: hook-creator
description: Design, create, integrate, review, test, and debug Codex lifecycle hooks from current official contracts and focused operational references.

interface.shortDescription: Engineer and verify Codex lifecycle hooks.
interface.longDescription: A focused Codex hook engineering skill that maps operational intent to the correct lifecycle event, matcher, handler, placement, input/output contract, trust model, and verification path. Covers command, MCP, background, managed, plugin, subagent, CI/CD, and GitHub Actions integrations without installing or activating hooks automatically.
defaultPrompt: Use $hook-creator to design and implement the Codex hook required for this workflow.
Use $hook-creator to review these Codex hooks and identify incorrect lifecycle behavior.
Use $hook-creator to debug why this Codex hook is not discovered, trusted, or executed.
